meta.name: Witch's Brew: Claims
meta.blurb: Over 3 sets, secretly hold 3 of 6 roles; leaders name roles, holders contest or yield, and the last contester clockwise takes the strong reward.

steps.label: a new set begins
steps.text: Set {set_number} of {num_sets} begins. All unused roles are lost and no role has been led yet.

steps.label: choose roles
steps.text: Set {set_number}: secretly choose the {roles_per_hand} different roles you will hold for this set. Nobody else sees your hand.

value.calc: [r for r in ['Witch', 'Raven Keeper', 'Alchemist', 'Druid', 'Herb Hag', 'Thief'] if r in you.set_pick]
[r for r in ['Witch', 'Raven Keeper', 'Alchemist', 'Druid', 'Herb Hag', 'Thief'] if r not in led_list]

steps.label: name a role
steps.text: You lead. Name one role not yet led this set. You may name a role you do not hold, but if nobody contests and you do not hold it, you get nothing.

value.calc: $nr in [p.hand for p in players if p.seat == leader_seat][0]

steps.label: talk
steps.text: The {named_role} has been named by seat {leader_seat}. Say one short thing to the table. Nothing said binds anyone.

steps.label: respond

to.where: you.seat != leader_seat and named_role in you.hand

steps.text: You hold the {named_role}, named by seat {leader_seat}. Contest to take over the claim (the last contester clockwise after the leader gets the strong reward; anyone overtaken gets 0), or yield to take the weak reward. Either way the role leaves your hand.

steps.label: the reveal
steps.text: Responses to the {named_role} [seat, response]: {[[p.seat, p.response] for p in players]}.

steps.label: the final claimant

value.calc: (max([((p.seat - leader_seat + len(players)) % len(players)) * 10 + p.seat for p in players if p.response == 'contest']) % 10) if count(p.response == 'contest' for p in players) > 0 else leader_seat

steps.text: Seat {final_claimant} holds the final claim on the {named_role}.

value.calc: witch_strong if named_role == 'Witch' else (raven_keeper_strong if named_role == 'Raven Keeper' else (alchemist_strong if named_role == 'Alchemist' else (druid_strong if named_role == 'Druid' else herb_hag_strong)))

adjust.text: Seat {player} takes the strong reward of the {named_role}.

value.calc: [p.seat for p in players if p.seat != final_claimant and p.score * 100 - ((p.seat - final_claimant + len(players)) % len(players)) == max([q.score * 100 - ((q.seat - final_claimant + len(players)) % len(players)) for q in players if q.seat != final_claimant])][0]

adjust.text: Seat {player} steals {thief_steal} points as the Thief.

players.where: (you.seat == leader_seat or you.response == 'contest') and you.seat != final_claimant

adjust.text: Seat {player} was overtaken and gets nothing.

value.calc: witch_weak if named_role == 'Witch' else (raven_keeper_weak if named_role == 'Raven Keeper' else (alchemist_weak if named_role == 'Alchemist' else (druid_weak if named_role == 'Druid' else (herb_hag_weak if named_role == 'Herb Hag' else thief_weak))))

adjust.text: Seat {player} yields and takes the weak reward of the {named_role}.

players.where: (you.seat == leader_seat or you.response != 'none') and named_role in you.hand

steps.label: next round
steps.text: Scores [seat, score]: {[[p.seat, p.score] for p in players]}.

over.text: Winner: {result}. Final scores [seat, score]: {[[p.seat, p.score] for p in players]}.

rules:
Players sit in a fixed clockwise order, numbered 1 to N. Everyone starts with {starting_score} points. The game has {num_sets} sets of N rounds each.

ROLES. There are {role_count} roles, each with a strong reward and a weak reward:
- Witch: strong {witch_strong}, weak {witch_weak}.
- Raven Keeper: strong {raven_keeper_strong}, weak {raven_keeper_weak}.
- Alchemist: strong {alchemist_strong}, weak {alchemist_weak}.
- Druid: strong {druid_strong}, weak {druid_weak}.
- Herb Hag: strong {herb_hag_strong}, weak {herb_hag_weak}.
- Thief: the strong reward is to take {thief_steal} points from the other player with the highest current total (ties go to the tied player first clockwise after the Thief). The Thief gains {thief_steal}, that player loses {thief_steal}, and a total may go below 0. Weak {thief_weak}.

START OF A SET. At the start of each set, every player secretly and simultaneously chooses exactly {roles_per_hand} different roles to hold for that set, replacing anything left from the previous set. Hands are private. The list of roles led this set is emptied.

LEADER. In set k, the first round's leader is player k. Leadership then passes clockwise each round, so every player leads exactly once per set.

EACH ROUND:
1. The leader is announced.
2. The leader names one role that has not yet been led in this set. They may name a role they do not hold. The named role is added to this set's led list.
3. Talk: every player at the same time writes one short message without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages bind no one.
4. Responses: every player other than the leader who holds the named role must respond. All of them choose at the same moment, either CONTEST or YIELD. Players who do not hold it pass automatically (response none).
5. Reveal: all responses are shown, so everyone learns who held the role.
6. Resolve: start from the leader and go clockwise. The leader is the first claimant, and each contester, in clockwise order, takes over the claim. The final claimant is the last contester in clockwise order after the leader, or the leader if nobody contested.
   - The final claimant gets the role's strong reward. Exception: if the final claimant is the leader and the leader does not hold the named role, they get nothing, and nobody gets the strong reward.
   - The leader, if overtaken, gets {overtaken_reward}. Every contester overtaken by a later contester gets {overtaken_reward}.
   - Every player who yielded gets the role's weak reward, whether or not anyone contested.
7. The named role is removed from the hand of the leader (if held) and of every responder. A role cannot be led again this set.
8. Scores are announced and leadership passes clockwise.

Roles held but never led or responded to during a set are simply lost when the set ends. After round {num_sets} x N the game ends: the player with the highest total points wins, and players tied for the highest total share the result (a draw).
